result.body:
I've been thinking about some minigames related to our @holozing project as I'm impatiently waiting around for the pieces of the puzzle to stick together and I remembered an old game I used to play with my parents. Wasn't quite sure what it was called, then found out that Ludo was trademarked so was kind of bummed out about it at first but then realized that it's actually inspired from an ancient indian game called pachisi! 

Did some more research, talked to Claude about how we should build it, it recommended [babylon.js](https://www.babylonjs.com/) since I wanted it to have 3d elements while at the same time working on a browser with low resource costs. 

Naturally it needed its zing so had to plan out the game ahead of time. First iterations weren't great: 


![prototype.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23uFwDbUZHcySXJNy4HAvUdAr8t28edvBbEcqj3YVNkNYv1zHZ1M6Q8y55oguHTrZvNY2.png)

but the idea evolved over time. 

Instead of just having models that move on the board on the roll of a dice, I wanted it to have more action on the board. 

I imported some important game logic from @holozing, i.e. creature rarity stats, creature stats, etc, it got so complicated at one point that I had to strip a lot of things away. 

As the game rules stand right now, for let's say version 1.0, are as follows: 

1 healer per player with mana, we currently have 2 healer models: Male Ocean and Female Forest.
3 creatures per player, 3 of the 4 starters: grass - Wrackoo, fire - Infurno and water - Walle.

Who starts is randomized, you need to roll a 6 to get a creature out on the field, rolling another 6 allows you to place another creature on the field (there can be more than 1 creatures on the same field currently)

Melee only for starters, creatures can be attack from a creature coming in from the back and being one tile behind as well as when they pass they attack enemy creatures on the way. 

Creatures have their own HP. 

To heal the creatures you have to be 9 tiles within your base. 

Creatures have to go around the board twice to be able to enter the "home" tiles. 

You need to place all 3 creatures in their home tiles to win the game.

Here's a screenshot of what the game looks like currently, keep in mind however we have yet to include the healer models.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23tkfcbhuHRkQheTw42cuZE2bSekSdzkPYgK7PQaFebeEiauLUerfVjmS3theXnyvt5FZ.png)


 They board is designed in a way where we can include ranged creatures later as well as give existing ones more moves, meaning when creatures are near the intersection they can perform ranged attacks on many nearby tiles, doesn't matter if they're on the same "path" or not. Currently melee attacks can still be performed at the intersection if creatures are close enough. 

The green and blue circle lets players know on which tiles creatures can be healed. 

A heal and its strength is also decided by the roll of the dice and each heal costs the same amount of mana, so you have to use them wisely! 


Giant Wrackoo is ready to fight!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23tkbcA2VpjJz1BjQ2wvHoxUcETPsZHQXWtvZuTfMkakMsgtiZfgg6QrEgJ3MFqcBkUUQ.png)

Anyway, still some things to polish, game needs to be added to the website, ways to enter games and invite other players needs to be created. Storing game results, awarding players some zing for playing - etc. 

Early requirements will be that you've bought at least one vial to play. Eventually you may need to have all 3 starters to play (or other creatures) and a healer. 

Some more things to mention I may have forgotten above. 

Some tiles have elemental domains, meaning when you're standing on them if a creature of that elemental type attacks you, you take additional damage. 
Other tiles are currently just empty but we can add some more stuff to spice things up. Testing and playing will be required to see if the game logic isn't greatly thought out yet or if there's some way players figure out how to always win, etc. 
If there's 2 or more creatures on the same tile, they all take damage from an incoming attack currently. We're leaving that as is for now and see how it develops. 
If a creature faints they go back to base and need to be placed back onto the board with a roll of 6. 
Obviously you can't heal enemy creatures nor damage friendly creatures. 

Let me know your thoughts and if you're ready to have some rng fun as well as maybe some strategy behind your playstyle in this @holozing minigame! 

We'll announce it on the main account when the game's ready to be played - along with many other updates we've neglected to get out for a while now (sorry about that)! 

##### Any other minigames you'd like to see in the holozing universe?
result.title: Pachisi!

<center>

As we enter their third week, they have put on more growth. Though I had to dim the LED light as it seemed a little too intense for half of them. Now the light is set to 25% and the distance from the seedlings is a little over two feet. Since changing the intensity the smaller ones are responding well. I try to mist them often, as their root systems are not established yet and rely much on their leaves for absorption of their water during the seedling stage. 

https://i.postimg.cc/gk9jP28D/P1017048.jpg

https://i.postimg.cc/hj4MPVZP/A1.png Strain:|Desfrán |
-|-|
https://i.postimg.cc/3NVZBV8d/B3.png Dominance: | 100% sativa
https://i.postimg.cc/FRPpf1wb/C2.png Nutrients used: | Happy Frog Soil / Ocean Forest soil. Big Bloom, Grow big:All FoxFarm products.
https://i.postimg.cc/D08g1nK9/D3.png Lineage: | Destroyer x Meao Thai landrace
https://i.postimg.cc/KcHQxkPx/E2.png Current growing stage: | Seedling |
https://i.postimg.cc/8Pf45p4W/F1.png Current plant age: | 20 days old
https://i.postimg.cc/vZRzxJ2K/G2.png Sex: | Feminized
https://i.postimg.cc/YC1x6dJC/H1.png Location: | Central Virginia


https://i.postimg.cc/jdV2rSPm/P1017053.jpg

The biggest of the bunch, is the one above. Honestly this one did not need me to turn down the lights. But its other sisters did need a little bit less light.

https://i.postimg.cc/3JMNHx2M/P1017055.jpg

We can see the leaf curling a bit, looks the new growth is not doing that so hopefully that was just a sign of stress when there was too much light.

https://i.postimg.cc/CLy5Vxk9/P1017058.jpg

These LEDs are all new to me, this is my second grow with them, so still figuring it all out.

https://i.postimg.cc/CLy5Vxk3/P1017070.jpg

I try to mist them a few times a day and so far they have only had one feeding.


https://i.postimg.cc/rF6sLw5c/P1017086.jpg

They seem to like the misting, I also have humidifiers keeping the tent around 70% RH.

https://i.postimg.cc/L6d5M8j2/P1017087.jpg

Basically they are reptile foggers that are piped into the tent that are attached to a device called a humidistat.

https://i.postimg.cc/hPFvqtVS/P1017093.jpg

Had to put on my macro lens for these pictures, glad I did. Get to see them all up and close.

https://i.postimg.cc/VLj6sPFy/P1017110.jpg

I feel like I am a little behind in this grow. I mean yeah there is growth, but I just expect more by now. Hoping they grow out of this, worst comes to worst in about 2.5 weeks I can start some new seeds and directly sow the cannabis seeds into the holes outside.

https://i.postimg.cc/jdz5qYhT/P1017112.jpg

But I do hope these take, as I get a jump on the growing season. They still have over two weeks to get themselves sorted out. And then I will put them in the ground if they are doing well. If not will need to get rid of the bad ones and start a few seeds. Pretty sure the one above will be just fine, just the other three are kind of small right now.

https://i.postimg.cc/VLj6sPFk/P1017115.jpg

But I see lots of new growth, and since lowering the brightness they seem to be overall more happy.

https://i.postimg.cc/Nf1MGvxf/P1017116.jpg

I think next time I will need to keep the light around 25% until they get much bigger.

https://i.postimg.cc/Nf1MGvx5/P1017120.jpg

Soon enough they will be outside in the full sun, so they can enjoy the dim light for now. But by May 1st they really need to shape up into some healthy plants ready to go into the ground. And then the long period of the summer here they should grow into some great cannabis plants with the right care.

### Previous posts on this grow:

https://peakd.com/hive-140635/@solominer/desfran-day-10


https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/solominer/242Dd9C2jF4NEnMg18iUNqcEwcDz5zrMyWaB4xWassopgTZoFzXmS5hxTovrH5f3p23h8.jpg

</center>

A new weekend simply means another chance to buzz the Hive blockchain, connect with one another, and simply have fun. You'll also agree with me that there’s something special about bringing everyone together to gist, share opinions, and enjoy good vibes. That is exactly the reason we will continue to meet every weekend.

**SPACE MISSIONS vs EARTH NEEDS**
___ Now to our discussion for this weekend! We will be discussing **"SPACE MISSIONS vs EARTH NEEDS”**. It’s been 9 days since NASA’s Artemis II mission began, where four astronauts embarked on a journey around the Moon to test the Orion spacecraft and its systems, verify human capabilities in deep space, and pave the way for future lunar exploration and landings. The mission has dominated social media timelines, with clips, updates, and discussions flooding the internet. While many people have been fascinated by the achievement of these astronauts and the promise of NASA's future space exploration, others have begun questioning the need to return to space again, and whether past lunar missions were true to words. Here’s the question! ***
Do you think missions like NASA’s return to the Moon are unnecessary at this time, given the many urgent problems on Earth that require massive funding and immediate attention? Please, expand your reasons
***
OR
***
Do you believe these lunar missions will lead to meaningful technological advancements that can improve our future, including communication beyond Earth? If yes, would you ever accept an opportunity to travel to the Moon?

If you have a topic you would like us to discuss in our future hangouts, please feel free to suggest it to us in the comment section and tag @sam.hangout to it.

## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUnKNEqsBYdEPtjPETrXQfkNKmzb6ChArTnfQnYR317V6/1775725362490.jpg) In this post I will share my experience while exploring the route on the edge of the tawar sea and the discovery of several popular tourist destinations,in this post we will see several areas that have been damaged by floods several months ago in Aceh, related to Aceh Tengah being in the highland area so the floods here are not too bad but experienced a fairly severe landslide, many areas have been damaged, some tourist destinations have even disappeared, but this all happened due to natural factors that were completely unexpected. Every incident will definitely leave an unforgettable impression and memory, whether it is good or bad also depends on how we go through it, look at some of the pictures below. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJjxh62KrFA4esqqhXaJniJqR1j69Pj11CneZ7StctUQ/1775725362737.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUNSsAbf3Gio6owE6PkmjZeRoEDpfFnrAWKbmQnBdDUh/1775725362816.jpg) This is a natural view around Mandale village, this village is located at the foot of the mountains and is also quite close to the tawar sea, here we can see many mountainous areas that have experienced landslides, some of which have even damaged many public facilities and buried roads, I can't imagine how horrific the scene was when the landslide occurred. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUTiy6borXvLmt2rqrMsEXJ5xD6YqRwuqQP1rnb6885aM/1775725362554.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRcnXVy4TnB14TdXpjUQPE9edVBKpWzJHy3LbAe37axxu/1775725362658.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV54hBgxwvcx47btHCbo5W3aV5jK99ZEfdCrrE4T8XPEf/1775725362895.jpg) The damage that occurred was really quite severe, not only was the land carried away by the landslide but wood and stones were also carried away, until now the damage that occurred can still be seen clearly, how this disaster has damaged and eliminated much of the beauty. The result is that during the day the roads will be covered in very thick dust and this will really disturb the surrounding air, but when it rains the roads will become slippery and muddy due to the mud. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJ1c2fLHZbo7ZebHYiNCqgwAqtyCKfyDpsXRFjy4EJxt/1775725362955.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHpBXGkLzpfkqLZxqD9TFwGQ9W2eJYL75Gnr9iRFsynJ/1775725363036.jpg) However, the natural scenery still looks quite beautiful, especially if we see it from the top of the hills, how the blue tawar sea water adorns our eyes and the mountains towering behind it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTcR8Zbw1XEkeHWstFxB6kFb3Rkb1HBrMKy6Qg9qzwf2/1775725363101.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3LRAPPPzn18KqLnSmyrZVFWrK7V5uFzsBXYGVZq5zba/1775725363162.jpg) And now it's time for us to explore several open natural tourist destinations in the Ujung Pasir tourist village, one of the most famous natural tourist destinations in this village is Jiva. Jiva is a popular camping ground-based tourist destination in Takengon City, located in Bintang Village, Lut Tawar District. It's actually been around for quite some time, but this was my first time visiting,i didn't know how amazing it was, but from what I'd seen and heard on social media, it was truly extraordinary. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR9jZRUKFRPh38Wp9THEm1rr1tDProGGdXQi1Me62Qhmd/1775725363232.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbSiVmE9eU75sjvrmHCFNFAQTAriDyMa51YdNFvcT7Csa/1775725363303.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeL2P81cTy6HpLAjb9JhQ7LDUtBwqSs2TDJD5WC4G11HW/1775725363383.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTA6bnFHBoL62EXvM3c89fHidMc6s7sZmAp6MLV3Kicns/1775725363475.jpg) To get to this tourist spot, we have to pass through the village road again for about 1 minute, it turns out that this tourist destination is on the edge of the tawar sea and the view can be seen from the road. As soon as I saw the natural scenery offered by this tourist spot, I immediately added this place to the list of the most beautiful tourist destinations in the city of Takengon in my opinion, it's a shame I always missed this place before,everything this place has to offer looks absolutely stunning, from the natural scenery, the facilities available to the many tents standing on the shore of the tawar sea. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbtUUA4vx2mB5bNMxyHhZpHQsPtyaxDTv6cKJbNwJAjC/1775725363546.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwKVUYyqjZ3T2qah8We91XmEcFfjSbWGgB9TNibAaDcf/1775725363616.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSeSMGEqnTRbzC6Zfo8j3P2cupLEjHTYH9yNW9PCJAddK/1775725363681.jpg) From the main area, we can see that there are lots of chairs and huts in this place, and also lots of tents lined up neatly on the edge of the tawar sea. This place has succeeded in making me comfortable and now it's time for me to explore it. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

If you like other travel posts, you can see them on [Worldmappin Community](https://v3.ecency.com/created/hive-163772) and you can also participate there. If you are curious about the places I have visited so far, you can see them on [my personal worldmappin map](https://worldmappin.com/@riyat) And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

result.body:
When I was a kid, the hottest band in the world (and my absolute favorite) was KISS. When I was five I got my first album, it was KISS Rock and Roll Over. When I was seven I received the KISS dolls for a First Communion gift... ironic I know. Later I wore out my KISS Alive Two record and watched KISS meets the Phantom of the Park about 53 times too may. But I never saw them in concert. Every time they did their "final" tour, I was too broke to go. Eventually about 20 years ago, I had the money but it just didn't seem the same going to see 65 year old guys dressed up in makeup and breathing fire. I was dumb. I should have gone.

![](https://images.kerrangcdn.com/images/2022/08/GWAR-JeremySaffer-2022.jpg?auto=compress&fit=max&w=3840)

For me, I imagined the second best thing would be to see GWAR. Last Thursday, I was able to scratch that off my bucket list. oh my god I am so happy I did.

Ok let's get this out of the way right now. You all know I hate spoilers but... spoiler alert... GWAR IS NOT BEING SERIOUS! They are comedians/performance artists. Their entire shtick is pure, unadulterated and brilliant satire. They are not Satan worshipers. They are not from outer space. They do not really shoot blood from every orifice in their bodies.

To be honest, perhaps my favorite part of the show was looking around trying to see if anyone in the audience thought this was all serious. I'd like to think no one did. But I do know that in the real world, MANY people think this over the top farce is serious... and dangerous. For years when talking heads on TV talked about the evils of Heavy Metal, they always seemed to use GWAR as the cherry on top. They would talk about how Heavy Metal would rot your brain, make you do drugs and of course worship Satan. They would show a few isolated lyrics form one band, show a couple of still images and then say something dramatic like... "and the there's GWAR." They would then show GWAR dressed in their ridiculous costumes while performing over the top gory stunts on stage... and they would act like it was real! It still happens today. After the first 20 seconds of the show, it made me question the intelligence of any person who didn't immediately get this was a complete joke. Now it is a dirty, disgusting and ridiculous joke, but it is a joke nonetheless. You can say you don't appreciate the humor, but for god's sake at least recognize it is in fact a joke.


![ "Screenshot 2026-04-09 at 6.57.01 PM.png"](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdTKw76tdjvc2t4fiWq784P361jhhtSAqtACc4yWxAc93/Screenshot%202026-04-09%20at%206.57.01%E2%80%AFPM.png)

OK so on to the show. It opened with ominous music and a voice over of a narrator saying "Throughout the history of planet earth one eternal truth has remained... eternally true. Might makes right! Those who hold the power make the laws control nations and rule the world..." Then they talk about shadow super powers running the word from smoke filled board rooms. They go on to say that there is an artifact that can save the world. It is the key to world domination. And what is this awesomely powerful object... its a dinosaur egg of course. And then for the entire show the dinosaur grows up and become super powerful. All the while some Sleestak looking mothertrucker tries to steal it for his own evil purpose. Remember when I said they were comedians.

In between scenes with the baby dinosaur (yes... I just wrote that) the band does play some pretty hardcore heavy metal with some pretty absurd lyrics. Just take a look at some of the song titles and I think you'll get a flavor of the evening:

Sick of You Immortal Corrupter Meat Sandwich Ham on the Bone Maggots Slaughterama Horror of Yig The Salaminizer Bring Back the Bomb Surf of Syn Let Us Slay If You Want Blood (You've Got It) Nitro Burning Funny Bong Gor-Gor (Also the name of the baby dinosaur) Tormentor

When they weren't protecting or chasing around that baby dinosaur, they were bringing out ridiculous caricatures of famous people and politicians and hitting them with gigantic fake swords that always resulted in the character spewing a fire hose of "blood" onto the crowd. People in the crowd actually had on full rain ponchos in order to avoid being covered in the fake blood. While these people wanted to avoid it, about 2/3 of the crowd reveled in the red goo.

If you have ever seen a metal show, the uniform of 99% of the crowd is a black t-shirt and jeans. But not at GWAR. You see, people want to remember their experience and prove they were there so white t-shirts are wildly popular at these shows. When I was first looking at the merch, I was surprised there were so many white shirts for sale. But once the roadie connected the first hose to the first "victim" I knew why they were so popular. As we were walking out of the show, anyone close to the stage who once had a white shirt was now wearing red. They all looked like they were stunt doubles in the pig's blood scene from Carrie. I mean people literally looked like they had taken a shower in Hawaiian Punch fruit punch. I did everything I could not to accidentally bump into anyone.

​
![Screenshot 2026-04-09 at 6.58.26 PM.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTDUNPykCBUfMkUWViKwji2Qou38A1X29uasX5JT8XhU/Screenshot%202026-04-09%20at%206.58.26%E2%80%AFPM.png)


All in all I am so happy I got to witness these brilliant comedians do their thing. I don't think I need to see them again but I was in awe of what I saw. The only way I would see them again is if I were doing what my friend did... take a newbie to see the show. Now it is definitely not for everyone but if you can handle over the top cartoon-like gore and some extremely dark satire, GWAR is the show for you.

Upload a video inside a **blog post** and it gets published as a standard 3Speak video. Upload inside **Waves** and it is automatically marked as a **Short**. The entire upload flow has been improved and simplified compared to the previous version, making it faster to go from recording to publishing. * * * AI Writing Assistant -------------------- An AI writing assistant is now available inside the mobile editor. Use it to draft posts, improve your writing, expand ideas, or clean up a rough draft - right inside the app without switching tools. You get a **daily free usage allowance** to try it out. Need more? You can spend **Ecency Points** to unlock additional usage. Points can be earned through your regular activity on the platform. * * * Translate Summary & AI Image Generation Boosts ---------------------------------------------- Two more AI-powered tools land in this release: * **Translate summary** - summarize or translate any post content with a single tap, useful for engaging with content across language barriers * **AI image generation boosts** - when generating images, you can now opt for the **2x, 4x, 6x power boost**, spending a few extra Points to unlock better reasoning and higher-quality results Both features tie directly into the Ecency Points system - earn through activity, spend on the tools you want. * * * Waves Redesigned ---------------- Waves got a full redesign this release. This update also improves bad actor detection - you will see clearer warnings when interacting with flagged or unfamiliar accounts, helping you stay safe. * * * Image Proxy Server Selection ---------------------------- You can now choose which image proxy server is used to load images across the app. If you experience slow image loading in your region, switch to a server that performs better for you directly from settings. * * * Unified Server List ------------------- The RPC and API server list has been consolidated and unified across the app, making server management more consistent wherever you access it. * * * PAT & Chat Fixes ---------------- Several bugs related to Personal Access Tokens and the chat API have been resolved, improving reliability for users who rely on these features. * * * Translations Updated -------------------- Multiple rounds of Crowdin translation updates are included in this release. Thank you to all our community translators who keep Ecency accessible across languages! * * * Under the Hood -------------- Routine dependency updates (tar, undici, sjcl, node-forge, lodash, activesupport) keep the app secure and up to date. * * * Update [Ecency.com](https://ecency.com) | [iOS app](https://ios.ecency.com) | [Android app](https://android.ecency.com) | [Direct Android APK file](https://github.com/ecency/ecency-mobile/releases) and let us know what you think in the comments or on [Ecency Waves](https://ecency.com/waves). 作为一名HIVE区块链上运行见证人节点长达近八年的见证人，一直以来我都很是关注自己和他人见证人节点的状态。

![020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9qfFoVKcwMwxxNASCDCC7ekexAu3RSRG5J85cf1KEfp/020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png)

为此我在很早就开发出了见证人列表工具（当前访问地址为：https://legacy.cutehive.com/）, 后来又在AI的帮助下，开发出来一个更优雅的版本：https://cutehive.com/witnesses）。

通过这两个工具，我们可以轻松地查看见证人们的运行状态，检查我们的投票，以便于我们投给节点状态健康的见证人。

但弊端就是没有对见证人节点的状态进行一个友好的解读，比如以下的一些节点，哪些是健康的呢？
![58ee02585fe58788b7b5d493d3bb5787.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8P7VfJwRw3A1yH9w9SG6EtMnGWU1zBbfSdpmTXqtaNb/58ee02585fe58788b7b5d493d3bb5787.png)

把节点的健康状态定义清楚，是一件很困难的事，需要考虑很多因素。但我想了一下，大概主要要考虑以下几点：
>* 见证人节点运行的软件版本（低于HF版本应该认为是不健康的）
>* 见证人节点距离上次出块的时间（很长时间没有出块应该被认为是不健康的）
>* 见证人节点的在线/离线状态（长期离线，应该认为见证人放弃了）

上述因素还有各种组合，我简单总结出来一些：

版本低于硬分叉版本但是还是在线状态——这样的节点会影响HIVE区块链出块的稳定性（尤其是排名靠前的），所以应该定义为最不健康的，大家应该及时撤票。

版本正确，还在线，但是很长时间没有出块，大概是节点崩溃了，管理者可能没有及时发现，或者发现了也没及时处理，这种也算是不健康的。

版本正确，还在线，但是一段时间没有出块。大概也是节点崩了，但是管理者可能正在维护（推荐维护时先离线），这种也是需要注意的。

离线超过一个月（30天），还没有重新上线的。我觉得可以认为见证人不打算干了，或者换ID了。这样长期离线的可以考虑撤票了。

中长期离线的（7-30天），有理由认为见证人没有重视维护自己的见证人节点，可以考虑撤票。

短期离线的（未超过七天），我们姑且认为此节点正在维护。可以暂时先观望一下，再决定如何操作（撤票或者保留投票）。

至于为什么不考虑丢块数、喂价、HBD 存款 APR等信息？因为HIVE/STEEM分叉期间，很多节点临时停摆，丢了很多块，不能反映节点的水平，而且排名100的节点和排名前20的节点一起比丢块数显然不合理。

喂价、HBD 存款 APR也很重要，但是相对于稳定地出块，这些信息就显得不那么紧要了，所以展示先不考虑。

虽然这些信息都可以通过https://cutehive.com/witnesses 获取，但是逐一判断还是太困难了。所以基于上述分析，我搞了个见证人节点运行情况评估工具。

对排名前300的节点，进行了一下评估，结果如下：

![f8e65a6ca93f98c84003a097434a0272.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcDDPTMK1HqsNaonnXJEWju5CUZSEGtXgtun1v9XZQz7/f8e65a6ca93f98c84003a097434a0272.png)

可见实际稳定运行的见证人节点还不足100个。

还停留在分叉前版本的节点（前150名）
![020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU9qfFoVKcwMwxxNASCDCC7ekexAu3RSRG5J85cf1KEfp/020324c4acf1deb68220f4d558bd7ccf.png)

出块停滞的节点
![591eccf2f2d10064c6365d2c06425342.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWSHkMDVnTPbMfJirjwTGkt2nu8tbrjyRb7JJhi5VXqvP/591eccf2f2d10064c6365d2c06425342.png)

长期离线的节点
![e3c52d42df069c312224f18c3e1b57be.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYkoBceypfeMx9M8DhMmb9Y3w5UJU2r4aJ4wP4tmyL1td/e3c52d42df069c312224f18c3e1b57be.png)

中短期离线的节点
![039324be80383d701d9e26f24c7b3fe0.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW5UPQaVbz8AoVSzUNgZSzgbv7yqJoM2MGSK7S4cpWHPE/039324be80383d701d9e26f24c7b3fe0.png)

短期离线的节点
![7738b0d0e3c50c0de7e27ebb15272c66.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVWANRS1GpJdJpZqt8Lq3H9R7P4PEdziUDfGieK5Bq5EJ/7738b0d0e3c50c0de7e27ebb15272c66.png)

见证人节点的运行状况大致就是这样了，建议根据节点情况调整投票。如果你不清楚或者懒得考虑支持哪个节点，可以将我设置为你的投票代理人哦。

这个程序还在调整优化中，一旦完善后会发布到HIVE开发者社区，供大家使用，敬请期待。

* https://cutehive.com/witnesses

![GridArt_20260409_221647329.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/Ep3hAAuSH5zx8ViSHqEU5SjAn96dgJcKQU5yisB2XeWC1KQcnQeKQibFi9hbZjHzrnh.jpg)
Buenas noches mis queridos lectores y seguidores espero que estén bien, la noche de hoy aprovecho para regalarle un contenido resaltando las relaciones familiares donde se narra la bonita experiencia, sorpresivo reencuentro familiar después de 8 años de ausencia. La semana pasada, a eso de las 8 de la mañana aún me encontraba aún durmiendo en vista de que ese día no me tocó ir a laborar, ahora bien mis amores les cuento que recibí la más sorpresiva y maravillosa videollamada, era mi primo quien se estaba reportando, en vista de que decidieron venirse de manera sorpresiva a Venezuela y tuve la dicha de ser la intermediaria y conocer esa maravillosa noticia, al llamarme recibí la información de que ya se encontraban en el terminal de Puerto la Cruz y venían saliendo para la ciudad de Cumaná y que nos íbamos a encontrar en el terminal marítimo con la intencionalidad de adquirir los boletos para retornar a su hogar maternal en la bella isla de Margarita, donde el resto de la familia directa no tenían ni idea de que ellos iban a pasar un mes de visita y poder disfrutar de la familia.
![GridArt_20260409_221740555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EonorM7AHtwvTsVGbq9K1tC4X9soNt93Yjc4X2HMZBxMxWhJ5HwxYGLWLvrS3V6c8zy.jpg)
Por supuesto, rápidamente accedí, me alisté y me fui al lugar del encuentro, estaba tan emocionada de poder de encontrarme con mi primo hermano y su esposa, después de largos ocho años de ausencia física, como no añorar y disfrutar de un caluroso abrazo de bienvenida con muestras de cariño y atenciones.
![GridArt_20260409_221907214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/EowKW4xUgsN8ikPbnGueAxfiNZDo2tXdrcchL7FnMZkHKKZcdn4VKKVcohEuCMwYVHi.jpg)
Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl
>Good evening, my dear readers and followers. I hope you are all well. Tonight, I'm sharing a post highlighting family relationships, specifically the beautiful experience of a surprising family reunion after eight years apart. >Last week, around 8:00 a.m., I was still asleep since I didn't have to work that day. Well, my loves, I have to tell you that I received the most surprising and wonderful video call. It was my cousin checking in. They had decided to come to Venezuela unexpectedly, and I was fortunate enough to be the intermediary and learn this wonderful news. When he called, he told me they were already at the Puerto la Cruz bus terminal and were about to leave for the city of Cumaná. We were going to meet at the maritime terminal so they could buy tickets to return to their mother's home on the beautiful island of Margarita. The rest of their immediate family had no idea they were going to spend a month visiting and enjoying time with their loved ones. >Of course, I readily agreed, got ready, and headed to the meeting place. I was so excited to finally see my cousin and his wife after eight long years apart, and I longed for a warm welcome and a warm embrace filled with affection and kindness. >Thank you for joining me here and see you another time. Thanks for reading me and your valuable support. >The photos are of me @cielitorojo with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Translated with Deepl translator.

result.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbS7HMNVR8gxA5XioZJsi3DTgEMA9R7BMffRs2RR8B3sq/image.png)

星期二晚上那一戰，打得特別激烈。我們的隊伍 Picklers 對上 Sun Peaks Pickleball Club，從對戰表一出來，大家就知道這不是一場輕鬆的比賽。

在這場比賽之前，我們暫居聯盟第一，他們排名第二，都是這個 League 裡公認的強隊。他們打其他隊幾乎都佔盡上風，只是曾經輸給過 Pickle Ninjas；而我們，則是有過險勝 Pickle Ninjas 的紀錄。從紙面實力來看，這一場基本上就是決賽等級的對決。

沒想到第一個 set 一開打，我們就被打得很慘。問題其實出在我身上，求勝心太重，每一球都揮得太用力，結果球頻頻出界，完全幫不上忙。對方穩定輸出，而我們一直送分，那個 set 幾乎沒有懸念就輸掉了。

這到了第二個 set，我開始刻意收斂力道，不再追求每一球都打死對手。球雖然沒那麼強，但至少能留在場內，來回變多，比賽也終於拉近了一些。比分咬得更緊了，但最後還是差了一點，又輸掉了第二個 set。

這時候，我的隊友其實已經有點放棄了。時間有限，前兩個 set 都輸，怎麼看都不像有翻盤的機會。我跟他說，別放棄，只要追到 2 比 2，就是平手。他一臉不相信，因為整場比賽只有 45 分鐘，這時大概只剩下 20 分鐘，要連贏兩個 set，真的很困難。

但我還是對他說，要拿獎盃本來就不是一件容易的事。如果這麼容易，每個人家裡早就都擺滿獎盃了。

於是我們就這樣硬著頭皮拚下去。第三個 set，我們幾乎把能做的都做到了，專注、穩定、少失誤，一分一分追，終於扳回一城。到了第四個 set，兩個人都已經累到不行，但腦袋反而變得異常清楚，只知道不能再送分。最後在時間結束前，我們居然把比數追成了 2 比 2 平手。

45 分鐘一到，比分定格。雖然是平手，但因為我在這場比賽之前的整體戰績比較好，按照規則，獎盃最後判給了我們。真的只差那麼一點點，稍微再打差一點，今天就什麼都沒有了。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdCBC9Lr1rMex9c7sPbjZ76LfC9wrown2TfwfKwWoTfMJ/image.png)

獎盃拿到手之後，我把照片分享到臉書和 Instagram，加起來大概也就一百個左右的讚，然後高興了一兩天。上一次拿網球比賽的獎盃，已經是十七年前的事了。到現在這個年紀，還能在場上拚、還能贏下一座獎盃，其實心裡是很滿足的。

當然，我也很清楚，這些終究都只是過往雲煙。就算你拿過網球的 Grand Slam，過幾年也未必還有人記得，何況只是這樣一個小小的聯賽冠軍。它的意義，大概也就是留給自己的一點 confidence boost，放進記憶裡，在某個平凡的日子突然想起來，然後會心一笑。
result.title: 獎盃終究只是過往雲煙
